title: CFDE Knowledge Center Public Webinar Series Features 4D Nucleome
bodyHtml: On February 28, 2025, the CFDE Knowledge Center Public Webinar Series featured Peter Park of the 4D Nucleome (4DN), who presented "4D Nucleome Turns 10: Mapping the Dynamic Architecture of the Genome." Dr. Park introduced speakers to the 4D Nucleome Project, shared analysis tools and workflows, and discussed insights provided over the ten years of the 4D Nucleome Project. If you couldn't make it, check out the webinar recording on YouTube.
